---
title: "Playground"
subtitle: "Explore brain atlas visualizations"
toc: false
page-layout: full
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script>
        const state = { atlas: 'dk', view: 'all', palette: 'region' };

        function updateDisplay() {
          const key = `${state.atlas}-${state.view}-${state.palette}`;
          document.querySelectorAll('.pg-plot').forEach(p => {
            p.classList.toggle('active', p.dataset.key === key);
          });
          document.querySelectorAll('.pg-code').forEach(c => {
            const matches = c.dataset.key === key ||
                            c.dataset.key2 === key ||
                            c.dataset.key3 === key;
            c.classList.toggle('active', matches);
          });
        }

        function bindSelectors(selector, stateKey) {
          document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
              document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
              btn.classList.add('active');
              state[stateKey] = btn.dataset.value;

              if (stateKey === 'atlas') {
                const viewRow = document.getElementById('view-selectors');
                viewRow.querySelectorAll('.pg-selector-btn').forEach(b => {
                  b.style.display = b.dataset.atlas === state.atlas || !b.dataset.atlas ? '' : 'none';
                });
                const activeView = viewRow.querySelector(`.pg-selector-btn.active[data-atlas="${state.atlas}"]`) ||
                                   viewRow.querySelector(`.pg-selector-btn.active:not([data-atlas])`);
                if (!activeView || activeView.style.display === 'none') {
                  viewRow.querySelectorAll('.pg-selector-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                  const allBtn = viewRow.querySelector(`.pg-selector-btn[data-value="all"][data-atlas="${state.atlas}"]`) ||
                                 viewRow.querySelector('.pg-selector-btn[data-value="all"]:not([data-atlas])');
                  if (allBtn) { allBtn.classList.add('active'); state.view = 'all'; }
                }
              }

              updateDisplay();
            });
          });
        }

        bindSelectors('.pg-atlas-btn', 'atlas');
        bindSelectors('.pg-view-btn', 'view');
        bindSelectors('.pg-palette-btn', 'palette');

        // initial view filter
        document.querySelectorAll('#view-selectors .pg-selector-btn').forEach(b => {
          if (b.dataset.atlas && b.dataset.atlas !== state.atlas) b.style.display = 'none';
        });

        updateDisplay();
      </script>
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(ggseg)
library(ggseg.formats)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

theme_pg <- theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines")
  )

set.seed(42)
dk_data <- tibble(
  region = atlas_regions(dk()),
  p = runif(length(region), 0, 0.05),
  t = rnorm(length(region), 0, 3)
)

aseg_data <- tibble(
  region = atlas_regions(aseg()),
  p = runif(length(region), 0, 0.05),
  t = rnorm(length(region), 0, 3)
)

tracula_data <- tibble(
  region = atlas_regions(tracula()),
  p = runif(length(region), 0, 0.05),
  t = rnorm(length(region), 0, 3)
)
```

<!--- dk · all views --->

::::: {.pg-plot .active data-key="dk-all-region"}
```{r}
#| label: dk-all-region
#| echo: false
#| dev.args: { bg: "transparent" }
#| fig-alt: "Desikan-Killiany atlas, all views, region palette"
ggplot() +
  geom_brain(atlas = dk(), aes(fill = label),
    position = position_brain(hemi ~ view), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = atlas_palette(dk()), na.value = "grey80") +
  theme_pg
```
:::::

::::: {.pg-plot data-key="dk-all-viridis"}
```{r}
#| label: dk-all-viridis
#| echo: false
#| dev.args: { bg: "transparent" }
#| fig-alt: "Desikan-Killiany atlas, all views, viridis palette"
dk_data |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_brain(atlas = dk(), aes(fill = p),
    position = position_brain(hemi ~ view)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", direction = -1) +
  labs(fill = "p-value") + theme_pg
```
:::::

::::: {.pg-plot data-key="dk-all-inferno"}
```{r}
#| label: dk-all-inferno
#| echo: false
#| dev.args: { bg: "transparent" }
#| fig-alt: "Desikan-Killiany atlas, all views, inferno palette"
dk_data |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_brain(atlas = dk(), aes(fill = t),
    position = position_brain(hemi ~ view)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno") +
  labs(fill = "t-stat") + theme_pg
```
